nodes.description: Public token symbol string; written only inside SetupToken.
Public token name string; written only inside SetupToken.
Constant decimals value (18).
Total token supply; set in SetupToken and read by totalSupply().
Owner address set in constructor; used as access-control gate in SetupToken.
One-time initialization flag guarding SetupToken.
Mapping of address to token balance; mutated by transfer/transferFrom and SetupToken.
Nested allowance mapping; written by approve and consumed by transferFrom/allowance.
Constructor that assigns the deployer-supplied address to owner.
Owner-only one-time initializer that mints supply and sets name/symbol.
Constant getter returning _totalSupply.
Constant getter returning balances[_owner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to _to with unchecked balance math.
Moves tokens from _from to _to using an allowance, with unchecked balance/allowance math.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] to _amount.
Constant getter returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Caller-controlled address used for access control and balance ownership.
Unchecked multiplication tokenSupply * 1000000000000000000 in SetupToken; can overflow in Solidity 0.4.11.
Unchecked subtraction balances[msg.sender] -= _amount in transfer.
Unchecked addition balances[_to] += _amount in transfer (guarded only by a same-value comparison).
Unchecked subtraction balances[_from] -= _amount in transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _amount in transferFrom.
Constructor parameter adr used to initialize owner.
SetupToken parameter tokenName assigned to name.
SetupToken parameter tokenSymbol assigned to symbol.
SetupToken parameter tokenSupply multiplied by 1e18 to set _totalSupply.
balanceOf parameter _owner used as mapping key.
transfer recipient parameter _to used as balances key.
transfer amount parameter _amount used in balance math.
transferFrom source parameter _from used as balances/allowed key.
transferFrom recipient parameter _to used as balances key.
transferFrom amount parameter _amount used in balance and allowance math.
approve spender parameter _spender used as allowed key.
approve amount parameter _amount stored in allowed.
allowance owner parameter _owner used as allowed key.
allowance spender parameter _spender used as allowed key.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter adr is assigned to the owner state variable, defining privileged access.
tokenName parameter flows into the name state variable write inside SetupToken.
tokenSymbol parameter flows into the symbol state variable write inside SetupToken.
tokenSupply parameter is consumed by SetupToken for the supply computation.
tokenSupply is multiplied by 1e18 without overflow protection.
Result of the unchecked multiplication is stored into _totalSupply.
msg.sender is compared with owner, gating the privileged SetupToken initializer.
owner state variable is read to authorize the SetupToken caller.
setupDone flag is read as a one-time execution guard in SetupToken.
SetupToken writes tokenSymbol into the symbol state variable.
SetupToken writes tokenName into the name state variable.
SetupToken writes the minted supply into _totalSupply.
SetupToken credits the whole supply to balances[owner].
SetupToken sets setupDone to true.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply.
balanceOf _owner parameter is used as the balances mapping key.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer _to parameter is used as the recipient balances key.
transfer _amount parameter drives the transfer arithmetic.
msg.sender determines whose balance is debited in transfer.
transfer reads the balances mapping for both sender and recipient.
transfer performs unchecked subtraction on balances[msg.sender].
transfer performs unchecked addition on balances[_to].
transfer writes updated balances back into the balances mapping.
transferFrom _from parameter is used as the source balances/allowed key.
transferFrom _to parameter is used as the recipient balances key.
transferFrom _amount parameter drives balance and allowance arithmetic.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked and debited in transferFrom.
transferFrom reads balances for source and recipient.
transferFrom reads the allowed mapping to validate the spender allowance.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction on balances[_from].
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction on allowed[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom writes updated balances.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance into allowed.
approve _spender parameter is used as the allowed mapping key.
approve _amount parameter is stored as the allowance value.
msg.sender is the owner key of the allowance being set in approve.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
allowance _owner parameter is used as the outer allowed mapping key.
allowance _spender parameter is used as the inner allowed mapping key.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter adr only feeds the owner assignment inside the constructor.
tokenName is a SetupToken argument written directly into the name state variable.
tokenSymbol is a SetupToken argument written directly into the symbol state variable.
tokenSupply is a SetupToken argument that determines the minted total supply.
_owner is only used as the lookup key in the balanceOf view function.
_to is only used as the recipient key in transfer.
_amount is only used in the transfer balance arithmetic.
_from is only used as the source key in transferFrom.
_to is only used as the recipient key in transferFrom.
_amount is only used in the transferFrom balance and allowance arithmetic.
_spender is only used as the allowance key in approve.
_amount is only stored as the allowance value in approve.
_owner is only used as the outer allowance lookup key.
_spender is only used as the inner allowance lookup key.
